title: 12 Best Reykjavik Craft Beer Bars
description: Discover Reykjavik's thriving craft beer scene! From pioneering microbreweries to cozy taprooms, find the top 12 bars for unique Icelandic and international brews. Your ultimate guide to hops in the capital.

places.name: Skúli Craft Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of Icelandic microbrews to sample diverse local styles.

places.name: Micro Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Anything from Gæðingur Brugghús, a renowned Icelandic microbrewery often featured here.

places.name: Hverfisgata 12 (Hverfi Bar)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a local sour or something experimental from their frequently changing taps, paired with one of their gourmet pizzas.

places.name: Gaukurinn
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Whatever local IPA or lager is on tap, often at a more budget-friendly price than other establishments.

places.name: Bastard Brew & Food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their house-brewed IPA and the Bastard Burger, a local favorite.

places.name: Session Craft Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their rotating Nordic guest taps for a taste of regional craft brewing excellence.

places.name: RVK Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A tasting flight of their core range and seasonal brews to get a comprehensive feel for their offerings.

places.name: Sæmundur í Sparifötunum (KEX Hostel)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Whatever local craft beer is on special, paired with their popular brunch items if visiting during the day.

places.name: Kaldi Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Kaldi Dark Lager or a seasonal Kaldi brew for an authentic Icelandic taste.

places.name: Bryggjan Brugghús
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of their house-brewed beers and some fresh seafood from their menu, like the Fish & Chips.

places.name: BrewDog Reykjavik
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pint of their flagship Punk IPA or try a limited edition brew from their guest taps for something unique.

places.name: Mikkeller & Friends Reykjavik
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their rare or experimental Mikkeller brews, or a specialty sour not commonly found elsewhere.
